summary.title: The Code Review Pyramid
summary.one_liner: A visual framework that ranks code review concerns by importance, urging reviewers to focus on behavior, performance and compatibility over formatting and style, which should be automated.
keywords: what to focus on in code review
takeaways: Code reviews often spend too long on formatting and style, while functional correctness, performance and compatibility get less attention.
The pyramid is a visual guide to which review aspects matter most, ordered by importance.
Mundane aspects such as formatting and style should be automated rather than discussed in review.
The visual is available as a high-resolution printable version and as an SVG download.
summary.summary: The post introduces the "Code Review Pyramid," a visual the author first shared on Twitter to help reviewers prioritize. It observes that review discussions often fixate on code formatting and style while important concerns such as whether the change does what it should, its performance, and its backwards compatibility for existing clients receive less attention. The page presents the pyramid as a permanent, referenceable resource, with a high-resolution version and an SVG download. The text is brief and the main content is the diagram itself, so the written detail on each layer is limited in the page text provided.
